items.text: The European Union (EU) started legal action against the UK because of its decision not to name a candidate for the EU Commission. The EU Commission sent a letter of formal notice to the UK, and the UK told it that it did not name anyone due to its upcoming general elections on December 12. British authorities say that the UK does not make nominations for international appointments during this period. The new EU Commission planned to start on November 1, the day after the UK was scheduled to leave the UK. However, British lawmakers did not approve the Brexit deal, which means that the UK is still a part of the EU, and the European Commission cannot formally start until all member states choose a representative. The UK has time until November 22 to respond to the notice. Difficult words: notice (a warning), nomination (the act of choosing a candidate for a job), appointment (the act of giving a job to someone), lawmaker (a person who makes up rules for a country) You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The European Union (EU) started legal action against the UK. The UK did not nominate its candidate for the EU Commission. British officials say that there are general elections in December and that the UK does not nominate people for international posts during this time. It was a plan that the new EU Commission started on November 1, one day after the Brexit. However, the new date for Brexit is in January, which means that the UK is still a part of the EU, and it must nominate a candidate for the EU Commission. The new EU Commission can start working only after all EU countries choose a candidate. Difficult words: nominate (to choose a person for a job), candidate (the person who applies for a job or other people nominate them), elections (when people vote). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The European Union starts legal action against the UK. The UK must choose a candidate for the EU Commission. British officials say that it is not possible. There are elections in December. The UK cannot choose a candidate for the EU Commission during this time. The situation is complicated. The new European Commission cannot start working without the UK candidate. The European Commission must start on November 1. This is one day after Brexit. However, the date of Brexit changes. The new date is in January. This means that the UK is a part of the EU. It must choose a candidate for the European Commission. The UK has time to choose a candidate until November 22. Difficult words: legal action (the process when a court helps to solve a difficult situation), candidate (a person who wants to get a job or other people choose him or her for a job), election (the situation when people choose a person or people for a job, usually in politics). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Spongebob Squarepants, an animated TV show created by Stephen Hillenburg, first appeared on TV in 1999 and it is still running today. Actor Bill Fagerbakke, the voice of one of the characters, remembers how he felt when he first read the script of the show. He thought that it was a weird show for small children; however, he soon realized that Spongebob Squarepants was unique . Twenty years later, an American TV network, Nickelodeon, is preparing a deal with Netflix. The two companies are working on a deal worth more than $200 milion. Netflix hopes to attract more young viewers to be able to compete with Disney Plus, a new platform with children’s programes. Stephen Hilenburg is excited about the show and he is happy to represent the value of animation to today’s children. Difficult words: unique (special), compete (to try to be more successful than someone else), value (the importance of something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Spongebob Squarepants is an animated TV show which started on TV in 1999 and it is still on TV today. Actor Bill Fagerbakke gave the voice to one of the characters. In the beginning, he thought that the show was not very good, but he quickly changed his opinion. He realized that it was very special. An American TV network wants to make business of more than $200 milion with Netflix. Netflix hopes to compete with Disney Plus, a new company with children’s programs. Stephen Hillenburg made Spongebob. He remembers how much he enjoyed animated TV shows when he was a child. He is happy to bring this feeling to today’s children. Difficult words: animated (a film or a TV show which uses art called animations or special computer techniques and there are no real actors), realize (to start thinking), compete (to try to be better than somebody else). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There is a very successful TV show for children. It is called Spongebob Squarepants. It is on TV for more than 20 years. People still like it today. Netflix is an American media company. It wants to do big business with another TV company. Netflix wants to make new parts of Spongebob Squarepants. It wants to be better than Disney Plus. Disney Plus is a new company with programs for children. Bill Fagerbakke is an actor. He gives his voice to one of the characters in the show. He remembers the start of the show. He does not like the show very much. He changes his opinion quickly. Now he is happy that children can watch it again. Difficult words: successful (something that does very well), media (the Internet, newspapers, magazines, radio, and TV), opinion (what somebody thinks). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Israeli Prime Minister, Benjamin Netanyahu, faces charges of bribery , fraud and breach of trust . However, in his speech, he criticized the charges, and he said that he will continue leading the country. In the first time in Israel’s history that a sitting prime minister has faced criminal charges. Netanyahu repeatedly said that he did nothing wrong and he wants further investigation. Netanyahu is not required to resign, but he has only 30 days to block the charges by asking for parliamentary immunity. This process is very complicated because Israel’s authorities are not fully functioning right now. Difficult words: bribery (an act of giving somebody money to make them do something), fraud (the crime of getting money by doing something bad to people), breach of trust (an act of failing to keep money or secret information), sitting (a leader who is waiting to end his job or is waiting to get elected again). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

For the first time in history, the Israeli Prime Minister, Benjamin Netanyahu, faces three criminal charges including bribery and fraud . He criticized the authorities, and he said that he wants to continue to lead the country. Netanyahu says that he did nothing wrong, and he wants more investigation. He can ask the parliament for immunity , but he has only 30 days to do that. There is a complicated situation because Netanyahu and his political opponent did not form a successful coalition . As a result, the authorities are not working very well right now, and it can take many months to charge Netanyahu formally. Difficult words: charge (an official statement that someone did something wrong), bribery (a situation when someone gives money to somebody else and they expect to do something for them), fraud (a situation when somebody does something bad to get money), investigation (a formal examination), immunity (a situation that protects a leader so he cannot get charged of a crime), coalition (a group, an agreement).. You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Authorities charge Israeli Prime Minister of three criminal acts. This is the first time in history when it happens. The Prime Minister does not agree with the charges. He wants to stay Prime Minister. He says that he wants to fight with lies. He wants to continue to lead the country. The charges are very serious . However, the Prime Minister says that he does nothing wrong. He believes that some people want him to leave his job. He only has one month to ask the government for immunity . It is not easy to get immunity. The political situation is very complicated now. The government does not work very well. It can take a long time to charge the Prime Minister formally. Difficult words: charge (to say formally that someone does something bad), serious (very bad or dangerous), immunity (a situation when a political person is protected and cannot get charged of a crime). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In 2003, Holidays Act law took effect in New Zealand, and many companies had problems in interpreting it correctly. As a result, employers miscalculated workers’ holiday pay. Unite Union alerted the company McDonald’s to pay its 60,000 current and former employees their missed wages in the total of about $28 million dollars. McDonald’s spokesman said that about 40,000 people could be eligible for back pay. The company has agreed to pay back 10 years in missed wages which were calculated incorrectly. Currently, Unite Union is fighting similar battles with companies Burger King and Armourgard. The Ministry of Business must audit around 150 businesses, and New Zealand’s government is reevaluating the law. Difficult words: alert (to warn somebody of a problem), eligible (having the right to do or get something), reevaluate (to consider something again). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In 2003, New Zealand’s government made a new law about holiday pay. Many companies did not understand it well, and they started to calculate their employees’s holiday pay incorrectly. New Zealand’s unions want the company McDonald’s to pay its employees more than $28 milion dollars‘ worth of missed wages . McDonald’s spokesman said that, in the last ten years, the company incorrectly calculated the wages of about 40,000 people, and it agreed to pay the missed money back. Currently, the unions are solving the same problem with companies Burger King and Armourgard. The New Zealand government must audit around 150 companies and make some changes in the law. Difficult words: holiday pay (paid time off work), wages (the money which employees get for their work), audit (to check, to find out more information). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In 2003, a new law about holiday pay starts in New Zealand. Many companies do not understand the law well. They start to pay people the wrong money for the time when they are not at work. The company McDonald’s has a big problem. For ten years, it counts the wages wrong. New Zealand’s unions say, that 60,000 people get less money. McDonald’s agrees to pay more than $28 million to its employees . About 40,000 employes can get the money back. The New Zealand government must check around 150 companies and change the law. Difficult words: law (the system of rules of a country), wages (the money which people get for their work), unions (a group of workers who work to protect all workers of a company), employee (a person who works for a company). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Last week, the Italian city of Venice was hit by the highest tide waters in a half century. Water levels peaked at just over six feet and caused a lot of damage to homes and businesses. On Sunday, water levels peaked again at nearly five feet, and they flooded already soaked shops, restaurants and hotels. The famous St. Mark’s Square was closed due to the rising waters. However, they did not stop some tourists from exploring the streets in rubber boots and plastic garbage bags. Officials declared a state of emergency in the area, and the mayor of Venice said that the floods caused damage worth hundreds of millions of dollars. Difficult words: peak (to reach the highest point), soaked (wet), worth (having a value in money). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Last week, the highest tide waters in a half century hit the Italian city of Venice. Water levels reached more than six feet, and they damaged many houses, shops, restaurants and hotels. On Sunday, water levels rose again to nearly five feet, and they flooded already wet shops and businesses. Officials declared a state of emergency and closed the famous St. Mark’s Square. However, some tourists decided to tour the city in rubber boots and plastic garbage bags. The mayor of Venice said that the damage is hundreds of millions of dollars. Difficult words: tide waters (water that comes when the sea level goes up and floods places on the coast), flood (to fill with water), declare (to tell officially), a state of emergency (when a place needs extra money and help to deal with an emergency). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In Italy, there is a city called Venice. It lies on many small islands. There are many canals and bridges. It can be dangerous when the sea level goes up. Last week, the water level rises very much. It damages many houses and shops. It is the highest water level in the last fifty years. On Sunday, more water comes and floods houses, restaurants and hotels again. Officials say that there is an emergency situation. They close the famous St. Mark’s Square. This situation does not stop some tourists. and they decide to tour the city. The mayor of Venice says that the damage is hundreds of millions of dollars. Difficult words: rise (to go up), damage (verb: to break, noun: the loss of something that breaks), flood (to fill houses and streets with water), mayor (the leader of a city). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Last year, Russia seized three Ukrainian military ships off the coast of the Crimean Peninsula. The ships tried to pass through the Kerch Strait, which is an important route for ships, and it runs by Crimea. Russia annexed Crimea from Ukraine in 2014, but the two countries share the Kerch Strait. Petro Poroshenko, the former Ukranian president, imposed martial law in reaction to Russia seizing the ships, however, the current president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, is trying to calm the situation. Just weeks before a Paris peace summit of Russia, Ukraine, France and Germany, Russia returned the ships to Ukraine. However, it is not clear what the state of the ships is and if Russia took their equipment and documentation. Difficult words: seize (to take something by force), annex (to take an area of a country by force and add it to one’s own country), martial law (a time when a military controls a government, usually in the case of an emergency). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Last year, Russia took hold of three Ukrainian military ships which tried to get through the Kerch Strait. Russia said that it was against the law. The Kerch Strait lies off the coast of Crimea, and it is an important way for ships. Crimea belonged to Ukraine, but in 2014, Russia took control of it and made it a part of the Russian territory . However, Russia and Ukraine share the Kerch Strait. After Russia took Crimea, the Ukrainian army started to control the country. The current president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, wants to make the situation better again. Russia returned the ships to Ukraine only weeks before a peace summit in Paris. The condition of the ships is not clear. Difficult words: take hold (to take something and to keep it), territory (an area that belongs to a country), share (to let someone else have or use something at the same time as you), peace summit (an international meeting of leaders of countries who discuss the end of a war or a conflict). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Last year, Russia takes three Ukrainian military ships. These ships want to go through the Kerch Strait. The Kerch Strait lies near Crimea. It is an area which belongs to Ukraine. In 2014, Russia takes control of it. Now, Crimea is a part of Russia. Russia and Ukraine share the Kerch Strait. However, Russia says that Ukrainian ships cannot go through it. In Ukraine, the situation is very difficult after Russia takes Crimea. The Ukrainian president wants to solve the problem. There is an important meeting of diplomats in Paris. Russia, Ukraine, France and Germany want to discuss the situation in Ukraine. Russia returns the ships to Ukraine just weeks before the meeting. Nobody knows if the ships function normally. They do not know if all documents are there. Difficult words: military (something that belongs to the army), share (to have or use something at the same time as somebody else), diplomat (an official who represents one country in another one). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The US state of New Jersey says that Uber owes the labor department around $650 million in unemployment and disability insurance because Uber said that its drivers are independent contractors . The labor department sent Uber letters that said that the company owes money for the past four years, and it will need to pay additional money, as a result. The situation may force Uber to make its drivers employees instead of independent contractors. This means that they would get higher pay according to state laws, which would increase costs per driver by over 20%. An Uber spokesperson said that the company is going to fight the labor department, and it could take years to finish this fight. Difficult words: labor department (a part of the government that deals with work), unemployment and disability insurance (the money that a US company should pay to protect workers if they lose their jobs or if they get hurt), independent contractor (a worker who works for a company based on a contract). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The US state of New Jersey says that the ride service Uber owes it around $650 million in unemployment and disability insurance . This is because Uber says that its drivers are independent contractors . This problem may make Uber change its drivers to employees, which means that they would get paid more. This can increase costs per driver by over 20%. An Uber representative said that the company is going to fight New Jersey’s action. The representative said that it can take years to resolve this problem. Difficult words: unemployment and disability insurance (the money that a US company needs to pay to protect workers if they lose their jobs or if they get hurt), independent contractor (a worker who works for a company from a contract or a signed agreement), resolve (to finish, to fix). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The US state of New Jersey is not happy with Uber. Uber is a ride service. The New Jersey government says that Uber owes it around $650 million. The money is for unemployment and disability insurance . This is because Uber says that its drivers are independent contractors . The problem means that Uber may need to change what it calls its drivers. The drivers can be employees instead. They can get paid more money. This means that Uber has to spend more money. Uber says that it is going to fight New Jersey. It also says that this problem can take years to fix. Difficult words: unemployment and disability insurance (the money that a US company needs to pay if workers lose their jobs or if they get hurt), independent contractor (a worker who works for a company from a contract which is a signed agreement), employee (a regular worker of a company who gets a regular amount of money for his work). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Last week, a school shooting happened at Saugus High School in California, USA, and the school had a detailed safety plan which may have helped the victims immediately. The school developed the 245-page safety plan in 2018, and the school extended a safety contract with the police in 2019. People at the school were also trained in lockdown drills and the use of Stop the Bleed kits . Stop the Bleed is a national initiative to train ordinary people to help with bleeding emergencies before professionals arrive. The safety plan also covered mental health counselors. Counselors are currently working with the school. Difficult words: extend (to expand, to continue), Stop the Bleed kit (a package of materials to help stop bleeding), initiative (a new program). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Last week, a student shot other students at a high school in California, USA, and the school had a detailed safety plan. The plan may have helped the victims immediately. The school created the 245-page safety plan in 2018. It extended a safety contract with the police in 2019. People at the school were also trained in lockdown drills and how to stop blood loss. Additionally, the safety plan required mental health counselors . Counselors are currently working with the school. Difficult words: extend (to make bigger, to continue), lockdown drill (when people lock doors and hide because a violent person is nearby), mental health counselor (a professional who helps people with their thoughts and emotions after a bad event). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Last week, a student shoots other students. This is at a high school in California, USA. The school has a safety plan . It is possible that the safety plan helps people right away. The school writes the safety plan in 2018. The school works with the police in 2019. People at the school learn what to do before bad things happen. They practice lockdown drills . They learn how to stop blood loss . The safety plan also asks for professionals to help. The professionals help people with their thoughts after bad events. Professionals are working with the school now. Difficult words: safety plan (a plan on how to keep a place safe during a violent event), lockdown drill (when people practice if a violent person is near them; they lock doors and hide), blood loss (when a lot of blood comes out of your body because you are hurt). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

For the first time ever, more Americans pay for digital streaming than cable or satellite TV. Reports say that in 2018 income for digital streaming services increased to $16.3 billion. In the US, there are more Netflix subscriptions than there are cable TV subscriptions. In the past, platforms like HBO Now or Netflix needed to convince the American public to cancel cable or satelite TV and pay for streaming videos. Disney Plus and Apple TV Plus are newcomers to the streaming industry; however, Disney Plus is one of the biggest competitors of the streaming industry ever. Experts say that this is because Netflix paved the way for the other competitors and Disney seized this opportunity . Difficult words: subscription (an amount of money that is paid regularly to receive a product or service), newcomer (a person or company that is new in a particular situation), pave the way (to make easier for others), seize the opportunity (take advanatage of something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Digital streaming is becoming more and more popular with Americans. Reports say that last year, people paid $16.3 billion more for digital streaming services than in the previous year. Companies like HBO or Netflix convinced people to cancel cable or satelite TV and pay for streaming videos. Currently, more people pay for Netflix than cable or satelite TV. Now, there are new players on the scene, with Disney and Apple. Disney is already one of the biggest companies in the streaming business. Experts say that Netflix did the hard work and prepared the ideal situation for other companies, that know how to benefit from them. Difficult words: stream (to send audio or video over the Internet without any breaks), convince (to make somebody believe in something), benefit (to profit from a situation). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

American viewers like digital streaming more and more. They do not enjoy cable or satellite TV as much as in the past. The money that companies get from streaming is the highest in history. People pay regularly every month to get Netflix. In the past, Netflix must do a lot of hard work to change the thinking of people. People start cancelling cable and satellite TV. They want Netflix instead. There are new companies which want to make business in streaming. Disney is the biggest company. It already has a very good position . Experts say that Disney is very clever. Disney does not need to work hard but waits for the best moment to start the business. Difficult words: streaming (to send audio and video over the internet without stopping), regularly (at the same time every day, month, year, etc.), position (a place where something is). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There are worries that Chinese telecom firms like Huawei can threaten US national security. However, these worries come from what is not known about them, rather than what is known. Currently, there is no evidence that Huawei threatened US national security. Some reviews have discovered faults in Huawei’s equipment; however, they have not found evidence of any dangerous activity. Huawei is a private company, but its relation to the Chinese state is not clear, and it is possible that the state can have an influence on it. Huawei’s officials promised more transparency about the company’s structure in the future. Only Australia, New Zealand, and Japan blacklist Huawei currently. The company is likely to provide a new generation of wireless networks worldwide, so national security remains an important question. Difficult words: threaten (to put someone or something at risk), fault (a mistake), transparency (clarity), blacklist (to list people or things that are regarded dangerous). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Some people worry that Chinese companies like Huawei can be dangerous for the security of the US. There are many things which are not clear about Huawei, such as its relation to the Chinese state . Huawei is not a state company, but it is possible that the Chinese state has an influence on it. There were checks of Huawei’s products which showed some problems. However, there is no real evidence that Huawei’s products are dangerous. Some countries put Huawei on a blacklist . This means that they think that Huawei can be dangerous. Huawei is one of the main companies which could prepare the new wireless network for the whole world; therefore, security is very important. Difficult words: relation (a connection), state (a government), influence (an effect), blacklist (an official list of people or things that are dangerous or can be dangerous). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Huawei is a Chinese company. It produces smart devices . It is the world leader in information and communications technology. Some countries worry that Huawei can be dangerous for their security. Huawei is not a Chinese government company. However. it is not clear if the Chinese government has some control over it. The US checks Huawei’s devices. There are some problems with the devices. However, nothing seems really dangerous. Some countries put Huawei on a blacklist . This means that they believe that Huawei is dangerous. Huawei wants to run the most modern worldwide wireless network . Therefore its structure must be clear. Its devices must be safe. Difficult words: smart device (an electronic thing that uses modern technologies and apps), blacklist (a list of people or companies that are dangerous), worldwide wireless network (a computer web that does not use any cables and can go all over the world), structure (how something is made). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

After weeks of protests, Bolivian president, Evo Morales, was forced to step down and take up political asylum in Mexico. The Bolivian Senator, Jeanine Áñez, declared herself the president , although she did not get enough votes in Congress. This happened because supporters of Evo Morales protested the vote. Áñez spoke in front of the Congress on Tuesday, and she explained that, according to the constitution, she was the next in line to become a president after the resignation of Evo Morales. Áñez also demanded that new elections will be held as soon as possible. The US President, Donald Trump, welcomed Morales’s resignation. However, family members of the US government employees are about to leave Bolivia because of civil unrest . Besides this, American citizens are recommended not to travel to Bolivia. Difficult words: political asylum (a situation when a country protects a person from another country who left their country for political reasons), i n the meantime (at the same time, in another place), (civil unrest (demonstrations, strikes and fighting between different groups of people who live in the same country). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The Bolivian President Evo Morales resigned from his job and took political asylum in Mexico. This happened after weeks of protests and military pressure. A Bolivian Senator, Jeanine Áñez, called herself the new president. However, she did not get enough votes because supporters of Morales did not vote. Áñez said that she wants to hold new elections quickly. She explained that she has the right to become president if the previous president resigns. The US President, Donald Trump, is very happy that Morales resigned. He says that this is the right way to freedom for the Bolivian people. However, there are many protests and fights, so US officials who work in Bolivia and their families must leave the country. Difficult words: resign (to leave a job), political asylum (a situation when a person leaves a country because of its political situation, and stays in another country), supporter (a person who likes a political person or party). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There is a difficult political situation in Bolivia. People protest against the president and his ideas . The Bolivian president leaves his post . He moves to Mexico where he is safe. Another Bolivian leader calls herself the new president. This is a problem because she does not get enough votes to be a president. Some people do not vote because they like the previous president more. There must be new voting. The US President is happy that Bolivia has a new president. He says that it is very good news for the future of Bolivian people. However, Bolivia is not a safe place. All US officials who work in Bolivia must leave the country. Difficult words: protest (a situation when people show that they are not happy with a situation or a person, usually in government ), post (a job), previous (the one before the existing thing ). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

On Tuesday, Israeli forces killed an Islamic Jihad commander and his wife which started a series of attacks in Gaza city. The cross-border violence caused the death of at least 34 Palestinians, and more than 60 people in Israel were also injured. Hamas, the Islamic terrorist group that governs the Gaza Strip, said that Israel continues its aggression and terrorism against the Palestinian people. However, after two days of intense fighting, the Islamic Jihad and Israel agreed to ceasefire . The Islamic Jihad agreed to maintain a weekly protest march along the Gaza border peacefully, while Israel agreed to stop shooting at protesters. Difficult words: commander (the leader of a military operation), ceasefire (an agreement in which countries or military groups stop fighting for some period of time), march (an event in which a large number of people walk in streets to express their support of something or their disagreement with something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

On Tuesday, Israeli military killed an Islamic Jihad military leader and his wife. This started a wave of attacks in Gaza City , during which a lot of people were killed and injured. The Islamic Jihad fired a series of rockets, which Israel’s defense system stopped. Israel answered with more airstrikes . Hamas, the Islamic terrorist group, criticized Israel for its aggression and terrorism against people in Palestine. After two days of fighting, the two sides agreed to ceasefire because of a protest march in Gaza. As the Islamic Jihad wants a peaceful protest, while Israel agreed to stop shooting at protesters. Difficult words: wave (a series), defense system (a military system of a country which helps protect it against an attack of another country), airstrike (a military attack by planes), ceasefire (a situation when two countries or military groups agree to stop fighting for some time), march (a way of support or protest, during which many people walk together in streets) You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Israel kills an Islamic Jihad military leader and his wife on Tuesday. This starts many military attacks in Gaza. The Islamic Jihad shoots rockets at Israel. Israel stops these rockets. It starts to attack Gaza from the air. These attacks last two days. They kill and hurt many people. Hamas is the terrorist group which controls Gaza. Hamas is very angry. It says that Israel is very violent . Now the fights stop. The Islamic Jihad and Israel agree to a ceasefire. This is because of a protest in Gaza. The Islamic Jihad says that it wants protests without any fights . Israel agrees with the Islamic Jihad . Difficult words: control (to have power over a place or people), violent (using force to hurt or kill somebody), ceasefire (a situation when two sides agree that they stop fighting for some time). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A US pharmaceutical company, Merck and Co., received an approval from the European Commission to sell the first Ebola vaccine. According to the World Health Organization, the vaccine is approved for people who are at least 18 years old, and it is almost 98% effective. The main symptoms of Ebola are fever, pains, diarrhea and bleeding. It spreads very easily from person to person through bodily fluids. In the largest outbreak , Ebola killed 11,000 people between 2013 and 2016. Currently, there are over 3,000 confirmed cases in Congo and more than 2,000 people have died. Merck has already given more than 250,000 doses to people in Congo. Merck’s offical said that the new vaccine is a historic milestone that the whole world can be proud of. Difficult words: pharmaceutical (related to drugs), outbreak (a start of a disease or epidemic), dose (a small amount of medicine that a patient gets at one time), milestone (an important event or stage in developing something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A US drug company got an approval from the European Commission to sell the first Ebola vaccine. Ebola is a very infectious disease which kills more than a half of people who get ill. The main symptoms are fever, pains, diarrhea and bleeding. Ebola killed more than 11,000 between 2013 and 2016. Currently, there are 3,000 cases of Ebola in Congo and more than 2,000 people died there. The vaccine is almost 98% effective and the drug company already gave 250,000 vaccines to people in Congo. The company says that this is a historical moment and very good news for the whole world. Difficult words: approval (a process when something becomes possible by law), infectious (able to be passed from one person to another), effective (with a good result). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A US company makes the first Ebola vaccine in history. It is a very important moment. Ebola is a very dangerous sickness with serious symptoms . It is very infectious and it kills many people. It kills more than 11,000 people in Congo between 2013 and 2016. At this time, there are more than 3,000 sick people in Congo. The company gives 250,000 vaccines to people in Congo. The vaccine is for people who are 18 years and older. It can save almost 98% of all people who get ill. The company’s official says that the whole world must be happy about this. Difficult words: vaccine (a special medicine that a person gets by injection and this person does not get ill), symptoms (signs on a body which show that a person is ill), infectious (it is possible that a person gets ill when he or she meets an ill person). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Chilean government announced that it will change the country’s constitution , which is a key demand from protesters all over the country. The protesters demand a better definition of human and social rights. The protests started nearly a month ago as a reaction to the rising prices of public transit. There has been a lot of violence and crime, and at least 20 people have died. The Chilean president, Sebastián Piñera, said that the government is working on a new constitution, but it will take some time. The new constitution will go to a public referendum and, it will take effect within two years. In the US, health officials at the Centers for Disease Control said that they may know what caused the nationwide outbreak of illnesses related to vape products. They say that vitamin E acetate may be the culprit . Product makers put vitamin E acetate into many food and skin products, and it appears safe to eat or put on the skin. However, when someone heats it and inhales it, it seems to cause many breathing problems. The health officials said that investigators tested samples from 29 patients who were sick from vape products, and the investigators found vitamin E acetate in 100% of the samples. Almost all of the patients also said they had used their vape products to vape the drug THC. Some makers of illegal THC vape products add vitamin E acetate to the products. The health officials said that there may be more causes of the outbreak. Difficult words: outbreak (a sickness or event that happens suddenly, and in many places), culprit (the cause of something, a person who may have done something), sample (some collected information so an investigator can test or analyze it). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The US Secret Service released a thorough report that suggested that many attacks at US schools were preventable. The report examined 41 incidents of school attacks between 2008 and 2017. The report summarized that most students who performed the attacks were victims of bullying, had disciplinary problems, and communicated their plans ahead of time. The reason for the attack usually was from problems with classmates or inspiration from other school attacks. The report also found that many attacks involved guns, and the attacker used a gun from his or her house or a family member’s house. However, the Secret Service said that the students who attack schools do not fit certain profiles . The agency said that schools need to identify students who show warning signs and get them help before violence happens. Difficult words: incident (a memorable good or bad event), disciplinary (relating to discipline or well you work with other people), profile (a description of a person who might do a certain action). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Many students who attacked schools were bullied, had behavior problems, and communicated their intent ahead of time. Many students used guns that they found at their homes or at a family member’s home. However, the Secret Service said that it is not easy to know which students may attack a school. The organization said that schools need to find students who show warning signs and get them help. Difficult words: comprehensive (thorough, detailed), commonality (a similarity, a pattern), intent (a plan to do something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The National Transportation Safety Board, NTSB, recommended that all US states require all cyclists to wear helmets. The reason is that between 2017 and 2018, there was a 6.3% increase in cyclist deaths which more caused by motor vehicles . The NTSB found that head injuries are the main cause of cyclist deaths but less than half of cyclists wear helmets. The agency says that using a helmet is the most effective way to reduce the risk of a serious head injury. The NTSB chairman said that more and more people were using bikes, so it was necessary to protect cyclists better. Currently, no states require that all cyclists wear helmets, but several states require helmets for children. Difficult words: require (to make something necessary), motor vehicle (a car, bus or truck), cause (the reason of something happening). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Difficult words: increase (a growth in number), significantly (very much), reduce the risk (to make it less likely that something will happen), means (a way or a method). Last Tuesday, the Yemeni government signed a deal with the separatists called the Southern Transitional Council, STC. The two sides signed the deal in Saudi Arabia’s capital, and broadcast it live on Saudi state TV. The aim of the deal is to end the power struggle which has lasted for many months. According to the Saudi ambassador, the STC will be included in a new government, and its armed forces will be under government control. The Saudi Crown Prince hopes that the deal will help end the civil war in Yemen which has lasted four years. Difficult words: aim (a goal), power struggle (a situation when two sides compete to get control or influence, and it is not clear who will win), armed forces (a country’s army, navy and air force). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The Saudi Crown Prince said that the deal can help end the civil war which started in Yemen four years ago. In Hong Kong, university students wore protest masks at a graduation ceremony. They did it in reaction to pro-democracy protests in Hong Kong that have lasted for many months. In October, the Hong Kong government banned demonstrators from wearing masks. The vice president of the university’s student union said that the students did it to defend their rights to freedom of expression and speech . During the ceremony, students chanted and held banners which called for the government to react to the protesters’ demands . These demands include the right to vote and independent police. University officials held the graduation as planned, but they cut it short. The police did not arrest any students. Difficult words: freedom of expression and speech (the right of all people to say openly what they think), chant (to sing or speak words over and over again very loudly), demand (a request). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The GLAAD Media Institute issued its annual report where it said that LGBTQ characters made up over 10% of all regular series characters on TV. This is the highest percentage since GLAAD started reporting. The report says that the majority of LGTBQ characters on TV are gay men. It also recommends that at a time when viewers have many options for entertainment, LGBTQ characters and their stories must reflect the real world. GLAAD wants to make sure that by 2025, 20% of regular series characters are LGBTQ. Difficult words: LGBTQ (a term used for the community of lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender people), majority (the most of), reflect (to show). You can watch the video news lower on this page.
